description:
Independent third-party patch bundle compatible with Morphe, maintained by **gggg-unit**. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by SD Maid SE, d4rken, the Morphe project, Doom, or Paresh.

The GitHub/FOSS build uses an honor-based support model. Its normal upgrade flow does not verify payment; this patch forces the local feature state on. It does not activate the Google Play build or make the user a sponsor. See the [developer’s explanation](https://github.com/d4rken-org/sdmaid-se/discussions/536), and please [support d4rken](https://github.com/sponsors/d4rken).

This bundle was applied to the official v2.2.2-rc0 FOSS APK using Morphe Desktop 1.18.1, and the injected bytecode was verified. Structural checks also passed on v2.1.0-rc0, v2.2.0-rc0, and v2.2.1-rc0. The maintainer reported successful on-device use on 2026-10-21; device and Android details were not provided. Future versions remain conditional on the same code structure, checked daily in GitHub Actions.

Select **Unlock Pro (FOSS)** in Morphe. SHA-256 of the unchanged v0.1.0 bundle: `49283160e200bb6bfad014b2dac735e83bfc07eac8d5a28baf3a669496a378f4`.

License and provenance notices are attached alongside this historical bundle. Releases from 0.1.1 also embed them in the `.mpp`. See the [current README](https://github.com/gggg-unit/sdmaid-se-morphe-patch#readme) and [NOTICE](https://github.com/gggg-unit/sdmaid-se-morphe-patch/blob/main/NOTICE) for credits, scope, and preserved upstream terms.
